description: The recorded AI-visibility history for one brand or domain: mentions, cited sources and competitors seen at each past Brand Radar scan, oldest first. Answers whether visibility in AI answers is moving, which a single run_brand_radar_scan cannot. Returns only scans that actually ran — empty for a target never scanned, filling in as scans run, with nothing interpolated or back-filled. FREE — reads recorded scans, charges no credits.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

target.description: Brand or domain, matched case-insensitively against past scans.

name: get_brand_scan_trend
